examples.japanese: ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{赤|あか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The light turned red, so the cars stopped.

notes:
{赤|あか} is one of the basic Japanese color words. Can function as a noun, no-adjective, or the base of the i-adjective ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧.

USAGE:
{赤|あか} is the noun — the name of the color — and is used when the color itself is the topic: {赤|あか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like red), ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{赤|あか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (the light turns red).

To describe a noun directly, use the i-adjective ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧ (⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧), not {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun is largely restricted to set phrases such as {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (complete stranger), where {赤|あか} carries the older sense "plain, utter" rather than the color.

FORMS:
- Noun: {赤|あか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like red)
- No-adjective: {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (complete stranger)
- I-adjective: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (red flower)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧: baby
- ⟦{赤|あか}ワイン→赤ワイン：18930_akawain⟧: red wine
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧: bright red; blatant (lie)
